title: Mr Simon Chesney — General Osteopathic Council decision (2023-05-05)
text:
IN THE MATTER BETWEEN

GENERAL OSTEOPATHIC COUNCIL

and

SIMON CHESNEY

UNDERTAKINGS FOR THE ATTENTION OF THE INVESTIGATING
COMMITTEE OF THE GENERAL OSTEOPATHIC COUNCIL SITTING ON 05
MAY 2023

I Simon Chesney of Little Summeries, Whielden Street, Amersham, Buckinghamshire,
HP7 0HU hereby undertake to the General Osteopathic Council (GOsC) that I will not
practice as an osteopath from the 28th April 2023 until the end of what will inevitably
be PCC Proceedings, whenever they may take place.

This is in order to resolve the issue of an ISO that is to take place on the 5th May 2023.

Dated this 28th day of April 2023

Signed

Simon Chesney
